```{r d13C mmodels}

m1 <- lmer(d13C ~ zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m2 <- lmer(d13C ~ zMAT + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m3 <- lmer(d13C ~ zEL + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m4 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm  + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m5 <- lmer(d13C ~ zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m12 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPE + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m6 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m7 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)  
m8 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm * zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m9 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm * zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m10 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm * zSP + zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m11 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCm + zMAP + zSP * zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m13 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPE + zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m14 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPE * zSP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m15 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPE + zSP + zPTCm + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)


aictab(cand.set = list(m1 = m1, m2 = m2, m3 = m3, m4 = m4, m5 = m5, m12 = m12))

aictab(cand.set = list(m1 = m1, m2 = m2, m3 = m3, m4 = m4, m5 = m5, m6 = m6, m7 = m7, m8 = m8, m9 = m9, m10 = m10, m11 = m11, m13 = m13, m14 = m14, m15 = m15))

plot_model(m11, type = "est")
plot_model(m13, type = "est")
plot_model(m9, type = "est")
plot_model(m11, type = "est")
plot_model(m8, type = "est")
interact_plot(m12, pred = zPTCm, modx = zMAP)

interact_plot(m12, pred = zMAP, modx = zSP)
cor(zMAT, zEL)
plot(zMAT ~ zEL)
plot(zMAP ~ zPTC)
plot(d13C ~ zPE, data = chimp_data)

interact_plot(
  m10,
  pred = zPTCm,
  modx = zMAP,
  mod2 = zSP,
  plot.points = TRUE,

)


summary(m5)

plot_model(m5, type = "est")

plot_model(list(m5, m1), type = "est", grid = TRUE)
```

```{r d13C coefplot and interaction plot}
combine_CIs <- function(m, model_name) {
  tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(term %in% c("zPTCm", "zMAP", "zSP", "zMAP:zSP")) %>%
    rename(estimate = estimate, se = std.error, stat = statistic,
           CI_95_low = conf.low, CI_95_high = conf.high) %>%
    left_join(
      tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.50) %>%
        filter(term %in% c("zPTCm", "zMAP", "zSP", "zMAP:zSP")) %>%
        dplyr::select(term, CI_50_low = conf.low, CI_50_high = conf.high),
      by = "term"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name)
}

coef_df <- bind_rows(
  combine_CIs(m11, "m11"),
  combine_CIs(m4, "m4"),
  combine_CIs(m9, "m9")
)

coef_df$Model <- factor(coef_df$Model, levels = c("m9", "m4", "m11"))

coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c("zMAP:zSP", "zSP", "zMAP", "zPTCm")))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
model_colors <- c("m9" = "#20B2AA", "m4" = "#5a9bd4", "m11" = "#2E8B57")

d13C_models_coef <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = Model)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_95_low, ymax = CI_95_high),
                width = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, position = dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_50_low, ymax = CI_50_high),
                width = 0, size = 1.5, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 2.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "zPTCm" = "Max Canopy Cover",
    "zMAP" = "Precipitation",
    "zSP" = "Precip. Seasonality",
    "zMAT" = "Temperature",
    "zMAP:zSP" = "Precipitation \n× Precip. Seasonality"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate", title = expression(delta^{13}*C)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.05, size = 15)
  ) + 
  annotate("point", x = 4.4, y = 0.3, color = "#2E8B57", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.4, y = 0.4, label = "m11: ΔAIC = 0.00, ω = 0.89", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("point", x = 4.2, y = 0.3, color = "#5a9bd4", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.2, y = 0.4, label = "m04: ΔAIC = 5.30, ω = 0.03", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("point", x = 4, y = 0.3, color = "#20B2AA", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = 0.4, label = "m09: ΔAIC = 5.51, ω = 0.03", hjust = 0, size = 4)

d13C_models_coef
 

ggsave("d13C_models_coef.png", plot = d13C_models_coef, 
       width = 6.5, height = 4,  
       dpi = 400) 


d13c_int3 <- interact_plot(
  m11, pred = zMAP, modx = zSP, 
  legend.main = "Precip. \nSeasonality",
  modx.labels = c("Low -1 SD", "Mean", "High +1 SD"),
  interval = TRUE,
  partial.residuals = TRUE,
  colors = c("#a1d99b", "#41ab5d", "#006d2c")
) +
  labs(
    title = "Precipitation × Precip. Seasonality",
    x = "Precipitation (z-score)",
    y = expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)")),
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )
d13c_int3

ggsave("d13c_int3.png", plot = d13c_int3, 
       width = 6, height = 5,  
       dpi = 400)
```

```{r d13C gams + lms}

#MAP
d13c_MAP_lm <- lm(d13C ~ MAP, data = chimp_data)
summary(d13c_MAP_lm)

cMAP_r2 <- round(summary(d13c_MAP_lm)$adj.r.squared, 3)
cMAP_pval <- summary(d13c_MAP_lm)$coefficients["MAP", "Pr(>|t|)"]
cMAP_pval_label <- if (cMAP_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(cMAP_pval, 3))
}

d13c_MAP <- ggplot(data = chimp_data, mapping = aes(x = MAP, y = d13C)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
    size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE), 
           y = min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", cMAP_r2, "\n", cMAP_pval_label)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(chimp_data$d13C, na.rm = TRUE), NA)) +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 13)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  ylab(expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)"))) +
  xlab("Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)")
d13c_MAP
```

```{r d15N mmodels}
m16 <- lmer(d15N ~ zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m17 <- lmer(d15N ~ zMAT + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m18 <- lmer(d15N ~ zEL + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m19 <- lmer(d15N ~ zPTCm  + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m20 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP  + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m21 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP + zMAP + I(zMAP^2) + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m22 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP + zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m23 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP * zMAP + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
```

```{r d15N coefplot and interaction plot}

combine_CIs <- function(m, model_name) {
  tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    rename(estimate = estimate, se = std.error, stat = statistic,
           CI_95_low = conf.low, CI_95_high = conf.high) %>%
    left_join(
      tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.50) %>%
        filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
        dplyr::select(term, CI_50_low = conf.low, CI_50_high = conf.high),
      by = "term"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name)
}

coef_df <- bind_rows(
  combine_CIs(m24, "m24"),
  combine_CIs(m23, "m23"),
  combine_CIs(m20, "m20")
)

coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = rev(unique(term))))

term_labels <- c(
  "zMAP" = "Precipitation",
  "I(zMAP^2)" = expression(Precipitation^2),
  "zSP" = "Precip. Seasonality",
  "zSP:zMAP" = "Precip. Seasonality \n x Precipitation"
)

model_colors <- c("m24" = "#8c3f5d", "m23" = "#6e4f2f", "m20" = "#e67e22")

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

d15N_models_coef <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = Model)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_95_low, ymax = CI_95_high),
                width = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, position = dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_50_low, ymax = CI_50_high),
                width = 0, size = 1.5, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 2.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = term_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate", title = expression(delta^{15}*N)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.05, size = 15)
  ) +
  annotate("point", x = 4.4, y = 0.4, color = "#8c3f5d", size = 3)+
  annotate("text", x = 4.4, y = 0.5, label = "m24: ΔAIC = 0.00, ω = 0.90", hjust = 0, size = 4)+
  annotate("point", x = 4.2, y = 0.4, color = "#6e4f2f", size = 3)+
  annotate("text", x = 4.2, y = 0.5, label = "m23: ΔAIC = 1.48, ω = 0.06", hjust = 0, size = 4)+
  annotate("point", x = 4, y = 0.4, color = "#e67e22", size = 3)+
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = 0.5, label = "m20: ΔAIC = 3.38, ω = 0.03", hjust = 0, size = 4)

d15N_models_coef

ggsave("d15N_models_coef.png", plot = d15N_models_coef, 
       width = 6.5, height = 4,  
       dpi = 400) 

chimp_data$zMAP <- scale(chimp_data$MAP)[, 1]
chimp_data$zMAP_sq <- chimp_data$zMAP^2
m25 <- lmer(d15N ~ zSP * zMAP + zMAP_sq + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)

d15n_int1 <- interact_plot(
  m25, pred = zSP, modx = zMAP, 
  legend.main = "Precipitation",
  modx.labels = c("Low -1 SD", "Mean", "High +1 SD"),
  interval = TRUE,
  partial.residuals = TRUE,
  colors = c("#c97e97", "#8c3f5d", "#5d263b")
) +
  labs(
    title = "Precip. Seasonality x Precipitation",
    x = "Precip. Seasonality (Z-score)",
    y = expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)")),
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )
d15n_int1

ggsave("d15n_int1.png", plot = d15n_int1, 
       width = 6, height = 5,  
       dpi = 400)
```

```{r d15N gams + lms}
#MAP
d15n_MAPgam <- gam(d15N ~ s(MAP, k = 3), data = chimp_data)
summary(d15n_MAPgam)
nMAP_r2 <- round(summary(d15n_MAPgam)$r.sq, 3)
nMAP_edf <- round(summary(d15n_MAPgam)$s.table[1, "edf"], 2)
nMAP_pval <- summary(d15n_MAPgam)$s.table[1, "p-value"]
nMAP_pval_label <- if (nMAP_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(nMAP_pval, 3))
}

d15n_MAP <- ggplot(data = chimp_data, mapping = aes(x = MAP, y = d15N)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Group, shape = Group),
    size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 3), color = "black") +
  annotate("text",
         x = max(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE), 
         y = max(chimp_data$d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
         hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4,
         label = paste0("Adj R² = ", nMAP_r2, "\nEDF = ", nMAP_edf, "\n", nMAP_pval_label)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 13)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  ylab(expression(paste(delta^{15}, "N (\u2030)"))) +
  xlab("Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)")
```

```{r Niche space gams + lms}
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(map_pval, 3))
}

map_seq <- seq(min(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(chimp_data$MAP, na.rm = TRUE),
               length.out = 100)

pred_map <- predict(MAP_model_gam,
                    newdata = data.frame(MAP = map_seq),
                    se.fit = TRUE)

  geom_point(size = 3) +

            aes(x = MAP, y = Niche_space), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(MAP = map_seq,
                                ymin = pred_map$fit - 2 * pred_map$se.fit,
                                ymax = pred_map$fit + 2 * pred_map$se.fit),
              aes(x = MAP, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
         x = max(map_seq), 
         y = max(chimp_data$Niche_space, na.rm = TRUE),
         hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3,
         label = paste0("Adj R² = ", map_r2,
                        "\nEDF = ", map_edf,
                        "\n", map_pval_label))+
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)", y = "Isotopic Niche Space") +
  theme_bw()+

gg_NS_EL

#Max canopy
PTCm_model_lm <- lm(Niche_space ~ treeCoverMax, data = chimp_data)

ptcm_summary <- summary(PTCm_model_lm)
ptcm_r2 <- round(ptcm_summary$adj.r.squared, 3)
ptcm_pval <- ptcm_summary$coefficients["treeCoverMax", "Pr(>|t|)"]
ptcm_pval_label <- if (ptcm_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(ptcm_pval, 3))
}

ptcm_seq <- seq(min(chimp_data$treeCoverMax, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(chimp_data$treeCoverMax, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100)

pred_ptcm <- predict(PTCm_model_lm,
                     newdata = data.frame(treeCoverMax = ptcm_seq),
                     se.fit = TRUE)

gg_NS_PTCm <- ggplot(chimp_data, aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = Niche_space,
                                     color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(treeCoverMax = ptcm_seq, Niche_space = pred_ptcm$fit),
            aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = Niche_space), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(treeCoverMax = ptcm_seq,
                                ymin = pred_ptcm$fit - 2 * pred_ptcm$se.fit,
                                ymax = pred_ptcm$fit + 2 * pred_ptcm$se.fit),
              aes(x = treeCoverMax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(ptcm_seq),
           y = max(chimp_data$Niche_space, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", ptcm_r2,
                          "\n", ptcm_pval_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Maximum Tree Canopy Cover (%)", y = "Isotopic Niche Space") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9))

gg_NS_PTCm


#Precip Seasonality
```

```{r chimp behavior}
behavioral_data <- read.csv("behavioral_diversity.csv")

# Linear model: Niche_space ~ behavioral_diversity
lm1 <- lm(Niche_space ~ behavioral_diversity, data = behavioral_data)
r2_1 <- round(summary(lm1)$adj.r.squared, 3)
pval_1 <- summary(lm1)$coefficients["behavioral_diversity", "Pr(>|t|)"]
pval_label_1 <- if (pval_1 < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(pval_1, 3))

# Linear model: Niche_space ~ foraging_behavioral_diversity
lm2 <- lm(Niche_space ~ foraging_behavioral_diversity, data = behavioral_data)
r2_2 <- round(summary(lm2)$adj.r.squared, 3)
pval_2 <- summary(lm2)$coefficients["foraging_behavioral_diversity", "Pr(>|t|)"]
pval_label_2 <- if (pval_2 < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(pval_2, 3))

plot1 <- ggplot(behavioral_data, aes(x = behavioral_diversity, y = Niche_space,
                                     color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 1.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(behavioral_data$behavioral_diversity, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = max(behavioral_data$Niche_space, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", r2_1, "\n", pval_label_1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(x = "Behavioral Diversity",
       y = "Isotopic Niche Space") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  )

plot1

ggsave("NicheSpace_vs_BehavioralDiversity.png",
       plot = plot1,
       width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")

plot2 <- ggplot(behavioral_data, aes(x = foraging_behavioral_diversity, y = Niche_space,
                                     color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 1.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black", size = 0.25) +
```

```{r tree cover}
m4 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCmin  + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m5 <- lmer(d13C ~ zPTCmedian + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)
m6 <- lmer(d13C ~ zpEG + (1 | Group), data = chimp_data, REML = FALSE)

aictab(cand.set = list(max = m1, mean = m2, mode = m3, min = m4, median = m5, pEvergreen = m6))
```

```{r tree cover fig}
# Linear model: Mean
mean_model <- lm(d13C ~ treeCoverMean, data = chimp_data)
mean_r2 <- round(summary(mean_model)$adj.r.squared, 3)

mean_p_label <- if (mean_p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(mean_p, 3))

d13C_TCMean <- ggplot(chimp_data, aes(x = treeCoverMean, y = d13C)) +

chimp_data_noTai <- chimp_data %>%
  filter(Group != "Tai")

d13c_gam <- gam(d13C ~ s(treeCoverMax, k = 3), data = chimp_data_noTai)

d13c_gam_summary <- summary(d13c_gam)
d13c_gam_r2 <- round(d13c_gam_summary$r.sq, 3)
d13c_edf <- round(d13c_gam_summary$s.table[1, "edf"], 2)
d13c_gam_pval <- d13c_gam_summary$s.table[1, "p-value"]
d13c_gam_pval_label <- if (d13c_gam_pval < 0.001) {
  "p < 0.001"
} else {
  paste0("p = ", signif(d13c_gam_pval, 3))
}

d13c_pred_gam <- predict(d13c_gam,
                         newdata = data.frame(treeCoverMax = d13c_seq),
                         se.fit = TRUE)

d13c_PTCm_gam <- ggplot(chimp_data_noTai, aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = d13C,
                                              color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(treeCoverMax = d13c_seq, d13C = d13c_pred_gam$fit),
            aes(x = treeCoverMax, y = d13C), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(treeCoverMax = d13c_seq,
                                ymin = d13c_pred_gam$fit - 2 * d13c_pred_gam$se.fit,
                                ymax = d13c_pred_gam$fit + 2 * d13c_pred_gam$se.fit),
              aes(x = treeCoverMax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(d13c_seq),
           y = max(chimp_data_noTai$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5,
           label = paste0("Adj R² = ", d13c_gam_r2,
                          "\nEDF = ", d13c_edf,
                          "\n", d13c_gam_pval_label)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Maximum Tree Canopy Cover (%)",
       y = expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (\u2030)"))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10))

d13c_PTCm_gam

ggsave("Figure3_d13C_treeCoverMax_noTai.png",
       plot = d13c_PTCm_gam,
       width = 5.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 400)
```
